This Polish stop-motion animator brings miniature food scenes to life using frame-by-frame animation: carefully moving each piece and capturing hundreds of photos to create the illusion of movement. Behind just a few seconds of animation lie hours of patience and precision. By using simple LEGO shapes to recreate everyday gestures — cutting, preparing, pouring — Łukomski transforms ordinary routines into charming and imaginative visual performances. ❤️ Artist: @hypnomotion #art #animation #lego #stopmotion #creator
